nodes.description: Counters.Counter tracking the running token id; read and incremented inside _purchase.
Constant maximum supply of 8888 tokens, enforced in the purchase functions.
Constant mint price of 0.08888 ether used for msg.value validation.
Constant per-transaction mint limit of 5 for batchPurchase.
Constant presale allowance of 2 per allow-listed address.
Public boolean gate that enables/disables public minting.
Mapping of allow-listed addresses to remaining presale mints; decremented in _purchase.
Mapping of token id to pseudo-random attack value; assigned in _purchase and mutated in upgrade.
Mapping of addresses to privileged operator flag, used as the access-control check in upgrade.
Private counter mixed into the pseudo-random number generation.
Mutable base URI returned by _baseURI and set by setBaseURI/baseURI setter.
Ownable owner address; source of the onlyOwner authorization used by admin functions.
ERC721 balance mapping mutated by _mint, _burn and _transfer.
ERC721 ownership mapping mutated by _mint, _burn and _transfer.
TTD constructor: stores the token URI, performs the initial _purchase and registers the deployer as operator.
Payable public mint entry point; validates mint state, limits, supply and funds, then loops _purchase.
Payable presale mint entry point gated on presaleMap[msg.sender] and TOKEN_PRESALE.
Private mint routine: mints to msg.sender, writes a random attack value, increments the counter and decrements the presale allowance.
onlyOwner function that writes TOKEN_PRESALE into presaleMap for each provided address.
onlyOwner toggle that flips the _mintStart mint gate.
onlyOwner function that transfers the whole contract balance to msg.sender via .transfer.
onlyOwner function that overwrites the TOKEN_URI metadata base.
Internal view override returning TOKEN_URI for token metadata.
Private pseudo-random generator combining nonce, block data and tx.gasprice; insecure on-chain entropy.
onlyOwner function that grants the operator role in operatorMap.
Operator-gated function that adds an amount to attackMap[tokenId].
Caller-controlled address used for minting, authorization checks, presale accounting and withdrawal recipient.
Miner-influenced timestamp consumed as entropy by _random.
payable(msg.sender).transfer(address(this).balance) inside withdraw: native value transfer to an external party.
attackMap[tokenId] += add inside upgrade: operator-supplied arithmetic write to token state.
keccak256 over nonce/block.difficulty/block.gaslimit/block.number/block.timestamp/tx.gasprice: predictable, timestamp-dependent randomness.
_mint with _tokenIdTracker.current()+1 and _balances[to] += 1: id derivation and balance arithmetic.
presaleMap[msg.sender]-- inside _purchase: arithmetic mutation of the caller's presale allowance.
Caller-supplied number of tokens to mint in batchPurchase.
Loop counter of the mint loop in batchPurchase.
Caller-supplied number of presale tokens to mint.
Loop counter of the mint loop in batchPresale.
Owner-supplied array of addresses added to the presale list.
Loop counter iterating over addrs in addPresaleList.
Boolean written into _mintStart by the owner.
Owner-supplied string stored into TOKEN_URI.
Modulus bound supplied to _random.
block.difficulty captured as randomness input.
block.gaslimit captured as randomness input.
block.number captured as randomness input.
block.timestamp cached locally in _random.
tx.gasprice captured as randomness input.
Final keccak256-derived pseudo-random value returned by _random.
Token id whose attack value is modified in upgrade.
Operator-supplied amount added to attackMap[tokenId].
Deployment-time base URI stored into TOKEN_URI.

edges.reason: msg.sender calls batchPurchase and is the address validated for minting.
msg.sender is read from presaleMap and used as the presale mint recipient.
msg.sender is the mint recipient and presale key inside _purchase.
upgrade authorizes the caller through operatorMap[msg.sender], so caller identity governs access.
msg.sender indexes operatorMap for the operator-role check.
withdraw pays the entire balance to msg.sender.
The constructor grants the operator role to the deploying msg.sender.
block.timestamp is consumed as entropy inside _random (timestamp dependency).
The weak-randomness operation depends on miner-controllable block.timestamp.
batchPurchase loops and invokes _purchase for each requested token.
batchPresale loops and invokes _purchase for each requested token.
The constructor performs an initial _purchase during deployment.
_purchase calls _random(9000) to derive the attack value.
The value produced by _random is used as the attack statistic payload.
_purchase mints the next token id through _mint.
_purchase conditionally decrements the caller's presale allowance.
_purchase reads and increments the _tokenIdTracker counter.
_purchase reads presaleMap[msg.sender] to decide the decrement.
batchPurchase requires _mintStart to be true before minting.
batchPurchase enforces totalSupply()+amount <= TOKEN_SUPPLY.
batchPurchase validates msg.value against amount*TOKEN_PRICE.
batchPurchase enforces amount <= TOKEN_LIMIT.
batchPresale requires presaleMap[msg.sender] >= amount.
batchPresale enforces amount <= TOKEN_PRESALE.
batchPresale enforces totalSupply()+amount <= TOKEN_SUPPLY.
setMintStart writes the flag into the _mintStart mint gate.
addPresaleList writes TOKEN_PRESALE into presaleMap for each address.
upgrade gates execution on operatorMap[msg.sender], relying on the operator role mapping.
setOperator grants privileged operator rights by writing operatorMap.
withdraw performs an external native transfer of the full balance before returning.
The onlyOwner modifier compares owner() (backed by _owner) with msg.sender before withdrawal.
setMintStart is guarded by the onlyOwner check against _owner.
addPresaleList is guarded by the onlyOwner check against _owner.
setOperator is guarded by the onlyOwner check against _owner.
setBaseURI is guarded by the onlyOwner check against _owner.
setBaseURI overwrites the TOKEN_URI metadata base.
_baseURI returns the current TOKEN_URI value.
_random increments and consumes the nonce state variable as entropy.
The pseudo-random output is produced by a predictable, timestamp-dependent operation.
upgrade writes into attackMap for the given token id.
upgrade performs attackMap[tokenId] += add on operator-provided input.
The arithmetic write targets attackMap, mutating token attack statistics.
The weak random value is stored into attackMap[tokenId] inside _purchase.
_mint increments _balances[to] as part of token creation.
_mint assigns ownership in _owners[tokenId].
The decrement mutates presaleMap[msg.sender] without any external reentrancy guard around it.
The constructor initializes TOKEN_URI from the deployment argument.
The native value transfer to msg.sender can execute the recipient's fallback/receive code, producing a callback into the contract.

normalization_plan.reason: Caller-supplied mint quantity is only meaningful as an argument of batchPurchase.
Iteration counter exists solely to drive the mint loop in batchPurchase.
Caller-supplied presale quantity is only meaningful as an argument of batchPresale.
Iteration counter exists solely to drive the mint loop in batchPresale.
The address array is only used as input to the addPresaleList owner routine.
Loop counter iterates only over addrs inside addPresaleList.
The boolean is written directly into _mintStart by setMintStart.
The string argument is stored into TOKEN_URI only within setBaseURI.
Modulus bound is consumed only by the _random helper.
Local cache of block.difficulty used only as _random entropy.
Local cache of block.gaslimit used only as _random entropy.
Local cache of block.number used only as _random entropy.
Local copy of block.timestamp used only as _random entropy.
Local capture of tx.gasprice used only as _random entropy.
The computed pseudo-random value materializes the weak-randomness unsafe operation.
Token id is only an argument selecting the attackMap entry in upgrade.
The operator-supplied delta is the operand of the attackMap addition unsafe operation.
Deployment URI argument is consumed only by the constructor.
